Each mango has a cost of $1.5 and there are 7 mangoes sold per year. Also, there is a fixed cost of $3 per year.

$$
\text{Total cost per year} = 3 + (7 \times 1.5) = 3 + 10.5 = 13.5
$$

#### 3. **Calculate the Profit Per Year**

$$
\text{Profit per year} = 10.5 - 13.5 = -3
$$
